summary.text: Dana Levenberg is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly who has represented District 95 since January 2023 and is running for re-election on the Working Families Party and Democratic lines.
She previously served as Ossining town supervisor.

paragraphs.text: Dana Levenberg was raised in Teaneck, New Jersey, and holds a B.A. in international relations from Brown University.
She worked in advertising and TV production in New York City before entering government.
She lives in Ossining with her husband, Stephen Hersh, and their two sons attended the Ossining schools.
Levenberg served as chief of staff to Assembly Member Sandy Galef, served nine years on the Ossining School Board, and later became Ossining town supervisor.
As town supervisor, she says she focused on building healthy communities economically, environmentally, physically and mentally.
Levenberg took office in the Assembly on January 1, 2023.
She serves on the Correction, Environmental Conservation, Housing, Libraries and Education Technology, and Local Governments committees.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she described her mission as building healthy communities in every sense and working to make the Hudson Valley greener, fairer, more prosperous and more affordable.
